title: Soft Decentralized Expected SARSA: Equilibrium Selection via Gradual Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2611.33228v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Soft Decentralized Expected SARSA (SDES), a modification of Decentralized Q-learning in which agents maintain persistent exploration and update their acting Q-values gradually rather than switching directly to newly learned best responses when updating. We prove convergence to $\epsilon$-greedy Nash equilibria in weakly acyclic stochastic games for sufficiently large batch sizes. We then show, in the repeated Prisoner's Dilemma with memory, that soft updating can reshape basins of attraction without changing the equilibrium set. In the deterministic limit, we derive analytical basin bounds governed by the Q-value differences between actions in the target policies and show that reducing the policy learning rate can favor either cooperative or competitive equilibria. These results suggest that soft updating is not merely a stabilization device but also a mechanism of equilibrium selection in decentralized learning.

translated_title: 软去中心化期望SARSA：通过渐进适应实现均衡选择
translated_abstract: 我们提出了软去中心化期望SARSA（SDES），这是对去中心化Q学习的一种改进，其中智能体保持持续探索，并在更新时渐进地更新其执行Q值，而不是直接切换到新学习到的最佳响应。我们证明了在弱无环随机博弈中，对于足够大的批规模，算法可收敛到ε-贪婪纳什均衡。随后，我们在具有记忆的重复囚徒困境中展示，软更新可以在不改变均衡集的情况下重塑吸引盆。在确定性极限下，我们推导出由目标策略中动作间Q值差异所支配的解析吸引盆边界，并表明降低策略学习速率可以有利于合作或竞争均衡。这些结果表明，软更新不仅仅是一种稳定化手段，更是去中心化学习中的一种均衡选择机制。
tldr: 该论文提出软去中心化期望SARSA（SDES）算法，通过渐进更新Q值而非直接切换至最佳响应，不仅证明了收敛性，还首次揭示了软更新可作为去中心化多智能体学习中的均衡选择机制，通过调节学习速率引导系统走向合作或竞争均衡。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Soft Decentralized Expected SARSA (SDES), which gradually updates Q-values instead of switching directly to best responses, proving convergence to ε-greedy Nash equilibria and revealing that soft updating serves as an equilibrium selection mechanism in decentralized multi-agent learning, where tuning the policy learning rate can steer the system toward cooperative or competitive equilibria.
